title: Fix framework spoke commands gap — create WAI-Spoke/commands/ symlinks to templates/commands/
summary: Regular spokes DO have WAI-Spoke/commands/ (verified in tracks spoke). The framework was missing it because it IS the canonical source. Fix: created WAI-Spoke/commands/ with 33 symlinks pointing to templates/commands/. Teaching prerequisite checks now pass against the framework.

analysis_correction.original_hypothesis: WAI-Spoke/commands/ path convention was wrong in teachings — should target templates/commands/
analysis_correction.actual_finding: WAI-Spoke/commands/ IS the correct convention for all spokes. The framework was the exception — it didn't have the directory because it is the canonical source, not a copy.
analysis_correction.root_cause: Framework never created WAI-Spoke/commands/ during its own setup — was not dogfooding its own spoke structure.

resolution.approach: Created WAI-Spoke/commands/ with symlinks to templates/commands/. Symlinks are self-updating — no shipit sync step needed.
verification: grep -q 'Do NOT skip silently' WAI-Spoke/commands/wai.md → PASS

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Completed task: framework now has WAI-Spoke/commands/ directory matching the spoke structural convention.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: A change to teaching authoring conventions or templates/commands/ content.
